headline: Archipelago mod remembers each save's room, and three mods get new releases
summary:
Eight pull requests from Lynder063 landed, with the Archipelago mod getting the most attention. It now remembers which room each memory card slot belongs to and refuses a save from another seed (#26), on top of a round of logic and client fixes (#24).

Three mods were released: `archipelago-v2.1.0`, `item-randomizer-v1.0.4` and `difficulty-v1.2.4`. Issue #25 asks players to help check the Archipelago and item randomizer logic by play-testing.
highlights: #24 corrects Archipelago logic rows checked against the decompilation, and fixes the client's seed check, reconnecting, compression and location ids.
#34 fixes the difficulty mod at enemy count 2, where extra enemies filled Blarg Station's object pool and the landing lost the ship and Clank.
#33 adds a listing field stating whether AI assisted a mod, required as a yes or no answer when submitting, and marks the 11 current mods.
The listing bot handles unchanged listings and missing repositories properly (#30), and now fails with a reason when a mod's newest release can't be listed (#32).
The mod index now rebuilds after a release (#27), and a failed publish alerts the maintainers on Discord (#21).
Draft #22 opened for round 3 of Ratchet & Clank co-op and has not merged.
